linkedshield.gui.title: Party
linkedshield.gui.no_party: You have no party yet. Invite players nearby.
linkedshield.command.damage.hint: FULL = the shield absorbs everything and loses the same amount; PIERCE = damage passes through by shield percentage; NONE = the shield ignores it. Single type: /linkedshield damage <damage type>
linkedshield.command.damage.bad_id: Not a valid damage type id: %s
linkedshield.command.damage.unknown: Unknown damage type %s (use modid:name for modded types)

linkedshield.command.bonus.set: Applied a max shield bonus of %s to %s; current max %s. (use 0 to remove)
linkedshield.editor.ui.title: Linked Shield Config Editor
linkedshield.editor.ui.subtitle: Minecraft 1.21.11 / NeoForge · target file %s · the save button writes straight back into this folder, in game use /linkedshield reload
linkedshield.editor.ui.grantNeeded: The first save needs one-time permission for the config/linkedshield folder (the one holding this html); after that the button writes straight back with no dialog.
linkedshield.editor.ui.dirReady: Remembered the settings.json folder — the save button writes straight back.
linkedshield.editor.ui.previewHint: The preview is drawn at true vanilla 1:1 scale (1 px = 1 GUI unit, no zoom) and sits below the settings. Drag an element to move it, scroll to resize: wheel on the party panel = panel scale (the same value the game uses); wheel on the shield bar = width, Shift+wheel = height. Click "Save settings.json" when done.
linkedshield.editor.ui.vanillaNote: The gray elements are drawn with the vanilla layout, so you can line your shield bar and party panel up against them.
linkedshield.editor.ui.importHint: Paste the contents of settings.json, then click the button below to overwrite the form.
linkedshield.editor.ui.fileNote: This page is generated by the mod and embeds a snapshot of your settings. If settings.json changes in game, just reload this page or paste the file above.
linkedshield.editor.ui.downloaded: This browser cannot write into a folder, so settings.json was downloaded — copy it into config/linkedshield/.
linkedshield.editor.ui.resetDone: Restored the mod's built-in defaults (not saved yet).
linkedshield.editor.ui.copyFail: Clipboard unavailable — the JSON was put into the box below.
linkedshield.editor.ui.dragList: Party panel moved — remember to click "Save settings.json".
linkedshield.editor.ui.dragShield: Shield bar moved — remember to click "Save settings.json".
linkedshield.editor.group.party.note: Party rules. The member limit also decides how many rows the HUD can show.
linkedshield.editor.group.shield.note: Settlement happens after armor, enchantments and effects, before absorption — the shield loses exactly the damage that would have reached your health. Pierce ratio = clamp(1 - shield/max, minPierceRatio, 1)
linkedshield.editor.group.damage.note: Damage is classified by damage type and vanilla tags, not by who hit you. FULL = fully absorbed; PIERCE = percentage pierce; NONE = the shield ignores it.
linkedshield.editor.group.linkedshield.n: Regen starts once the linkedshield has more than 1 member and stays that way for startDelaySeconds; breaking the link restarts the timer.
linkedshield.editor.group.combat.note: How long after the last damage you are considered out of combat.
linkedshield.editor.group.partyList.note: FF14-style party list along the edge of the screen.
linkedshield.editor.group.selfShield.not: Drawn above the health bar (position is configurable). Drag it or use the wheel in the preview.
linkedshield.editor.group.icon.note: Blue shield icon left of the hearts while linkedshield is active; the number in its corner is the linked member count (including you).
linkedshield.editor.group.api: Extension API for other mods (not a setting)
linkedshield.editor.group.api.note: Three ways in: ① item component linkedshield:shield_bonus (/give @s minecraft:diamond_chestplate[linkedshield:shield_bonus=25] or /linkedshield bonus 25); ② events LinkedShieldEvent.MaxShield / Changed / Broken; ③ the static API LinkedShieldAPI (getShield / getEffectiveMaxShield / setShield / addShield / setBaseMaxShield / refreshBonuses / isLinkedShieldActive).
linkedshield.editor.field.party.friendly: Off by default: teammates cannot hurt each other.
linkedshield.editor.field.party.nearbyRa: Nearby-player radius for the party screen
10 blocks by default: who shows up in the party screen opened with U.
linkedshield.editor.field.shield.default: Base value for new players; items and trinkets can add more.
linkedshield.editor.field.shield.minPier: Minimum pierce ratio at full shield
0.10 = 10% of the damage still gets through at full shield.
linkedshield.editor.field.shield.rangedD: Turn off to absorb ranged damage by shield percentage instead.
linkedshield.editor.field.shield.meleeDr: Turn off to only reduce damage without spending shield.
linkedshield.editor.field.shield.shieldB: Extra regen delay after a shield break (s)
linkedshield.editor.field.damageRules.us: Turn off to fall back to the old direct-entity check.
linkedshield.editor.field.damageRules.pr: FULL by default: everything in #minecraft:is_projectile, plus lightning_bolt (lightning) and thorns.
linkedshield.editor.field.damageRules.do: FULL by default: absorbed just like ranged damage.
linkedshield.editor.field.damageRules.me: PIERCE by default. Player and mob attacks, mace, bees, spear, plus cactus, sweet berry bush, cramming, fall, ender pearl, fly into wall, stalagmite, anvil/falling block/stalactite.
linkedshield.editor.field.damageRules.ex: PIERCE by default: exactly the same percentage formula as melee.
linkedshield.editor.field.damageRules.ma: Magic and sound (guardian laser/warden sonic boom/dragon breath)
FULL by default: absorbed like ranged damage.
linkedshield.editor.field.damageRules.ex: Comma separated, e.g. minecraft:spit (llama spit is missing from the vanilla tag).
Also treat as damage over time
linkedshield.editor.field.damageRules.fa: Fall back to the direct entity for unknown damage
Keeps modded content interacting with the shield.
linkedshield.editor.field.linkedshield.s: 0 by default: no regen without teammates.
2 seconds by default: more than 1 member, continuously for that long.
linkedshield.editor.field.linkedshield.r: Also require being out of combat
Off by default: only the link duration matters.
linkedshield.editor.field.linkedshield.o: Out-of-combat delay (s, only if the option above is on)
2 seconds by default; the larger of this and combat.combatTagSeconds is used.
linkedshield.editor.field.linkedshield.s: Stop regen when the shield is full
linkedshield.editor.field.combat.combatT: 2 by default: 2 seconds after the last damage you count as out of combat.
LEFT = far left (default); RIGHT = far right.
0.8 by default: smaller is more compact (name font scales too).
ABOVE_BAR = above the health bar; INSIDE_BAR = inside it; LEFT = left of it.
linkedshield.editor.field.hud.selfShield: ABOVE_HEALTH = right above health (default); CUSTOM = manual offsets only.
CURRENT by default: only the live shield value, no maximum or percentage.
